connector.name: Better Call Claude
connector.registryDescription: Voice Calls, SMS, and WhatsApp for Claude Code with cross-channel context sharing.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package better-call-claude. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sns45 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_PHONE_NUMBER
env.description: Your phone number in E.164 format

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_PHONE_ACCOUNT_SID
env.description: Twilio Account SID or Telnyx API Key

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_PHONE_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Twilio Auth Token or Telnyx API Secret

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_USER_PHONE_NUMBER
env.description: Your personal phone number in E.164 format (for outbound calls/SMS)

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for speech-to-text (Whisper) and text-to-speech

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER
env.description: WhatsApp number if different from phone number (e.g., Twilio Sandbox)

env.name: TAILSCALE_HOSTNAME
env.description: Override Tailscale hostname for webhook URL

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_WHATSAPP_PROVIDER
env.description: WhatsApp provider: set to 'baileys' for free WhatsApp via WebSocket (no Twilio needed)

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_BAILEYS_AUTH_DIR
env.description: Path to Baileys auth state directory (default: data/baileys-auth)

env.name: BETTERCALLCLAUDE_WHATSAPP_CHAT_HISTORY_SIZE
env.description: Max WhatsApp chat history messages to retain (default: 50)
